tools.name: search_threads
tools.title: Search threads
tools.description: Search the user's mail threads with a Gmail query and return thread ids and snippets, newest first. The query uses Gmail search syntax, for example `from:alice@example.com is:unread newer_than:7d`. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page.

labelIds.description: Only return threads with labels that match all of the specified label IDs.

maxResults.description: Threads per page, 1-500 (default 100). Use 10-25 for a first look.

pageToken.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.

q.description: Gmail search query, for example `subject:invoice has:attachment after:2026/10/01`.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.title: Read a thread
tools.description: Read every message of one thread by its id (from search_threads), oldest first. format=metadata returns headers only (pick them with metadataHeaders, for example From, To, Subject, Date); format=full also returns bodies, base64url-encoded in payload.parts[].body.data.

id.description: The ID of the thread to retrieve.

format.description: The format to return the messages in.

metadataHeaders.description: When given and format is METADATA, only include headers specified.

tools.name: get_message
tools.title: Read a message
tools.description: Read one message by its id, for example 18c2f0d7a1b2c3d4. format=metadata returns headers only; format=full returns the body parts, base64url-encoded; format=raw returns the whole RFC 2822 message in raw.

id.description: The ID of the message to retrieve. This ID is usually retrieved using `messages.list`. The ID is also contained in the result when a message is inserted (`messages.insert`) or imported (`messages.import`).

format.description: The format to return the message in.

metadataHeaders.description: When given and format is `METADATA`, only include headers specified.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the mailbox's labels: system labels such as INBOX, SENT, UNREAD and STARRED, and the user's own, with their ids (for example Label_12). Use the ids with modify_thread.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get the mailbox profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's email address and message and thread totals, for example {"emailAddress": "alice@example.com", "messagesTotal": 1532}. Use it to learn which mailbox is connected.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description:
Send an email. raw is the whole RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded, for example the encoding of "To: bob@example.com
Subject: Hello

Hi Bob". To reply in a thread, set threadId and put In-Reply-To and References headers in the message.

raw.description: The entire email message in an RFC 2822 formatted and base64url encoded string. Returned in `messages.get` and `drafts.get` responses when the `format=RAW` parameter is supplied. @required gmail.users.drafts.create gmail.users.drafts.update

threadId.description: The ID of the thread the message belongs to. To add a message or draft to a thread, the following criteria must be met: 1. The requested `threadId` must be specified on the `Message` or `Draft.Message` you supply with your request. 2. The `References` and `In-Reply-To` headers must be set in compliance with the [RFC 2822](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2822) standard. 3. The `Subject` headers must match.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.title: Create a draft
tools.description: Save a draft without sending it. message.raw is the RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded; set message.threadId to draft a reply in a thread. Returns the draft id for send_draft.

message.description: The message content of the draft.

raw.description: The entire email message in an RFC 2822 formatted and base64url encoded string. Returned in `messages.get` and `drafts.get` responses when the `format=RAW` parameter is supplied. @required gmail.users.drafts.create gmail.users.drafts.update

threadId.description: The ID of the thread the message belongs to. To add a message or draft to a thread, the following criteria must be met: 1. The requested `threadId` must be specified on the `Message` or `Draft.Message` you supply with your request. 2. The `References` and `In-Reply-To` headers must be set in compliance with the [RFC 2822](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2822) standard. 3. The `Subject` headers must match.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.title: Send a draft
tools.description: Send a draft saved earlier, by the id create_draft returned, for example r-5108413232411426193. The draft is removed and the sent message is returned.

id.description: The immutable ID of the draft.

tools.name: modify_thread
tools.title: Change a thread's labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on every message of a thread, by label id from list_labels. For example remove UNREAD to mark it read, or add STARRED. Adding a label it already has changes nothing.

id.description: The ID of the thread to modify.

addLabelIds.description: A list of IDs of labels to add to this thread. You can add up to 100 labels with each update.

removeLabelIds.description: A list of IDs of labels to remove from this thread. You can remove up to 100 labels with each update.

body.description: The labels to add and remove.

tools.name: trash_message
tools.title: Move a message to the trash
tools.description: Move one message to the trash, by its id. Gmail deletes trashed messages for good after 30 days.

id.description: The ID of the message to Trash.
